svg.title: Nominal field reconstruction at the source-pulse midpoint
svg.desc: Full-order, POD and POD-DEIM synthetic concentration fields at 660 seconds for the nominal holdout, with the absolute POD-DEIM error. The fields are numerical passive-scalar surrogates, not calibrated indoor measurements.
